correctness.rationale: The superdiagonal Lie filtration gives the universal upper bound; the binomial identity for commuting left and right multiplication gives each terminal coefficient explicitly; Lucas congruences count its surviving indices. Coordinate zero patterns prove the rank criterion, count and irreducible decomposition. Each step is algebraic over arbitrary characteristic. Every input is enumerated for ten small (q,n) pairs by an independent direct-commutator verifier; checks reproduce both the full criterion and all nonzero terminal coefficients. Experiments are corroboration, not an infinite proof.

value.rationale: The nilradical of a type-A Borel is a canonical Lie algebra, and the nilpotency index of ad_X is the natural elementwise Engel invariant. The theorem classifies the extremal index locus for every n and finite characteristic, counts its F_q-points, proves a unique top Jordan block, and gives an exact modular geometric transition from irreducible-component hypersurfaces to exclusively codimension-two coordinate flats. That transition is controlled by a distinctive base-p digital condition and cannot be inferred from a generic nilpotence observation.
